simple.text: **Aspect of the Beast** 10 s before the pull.
**Move to 11 yd** 5 s before the pull.
**Aimed Shot** 2 s before the pull, from 11 yd.
**Demonic Rune** when {Missing mana} or more mana is missing.
**Major Mana Potion** when {Missing mana} or more mana is missing.
**Rapid Fire** at the pull, or from 5 s into the fight with Summon Hawk or Bestial Wrath.
**Any other cooldown** when ready (Bestial Wrath, Intimidation, trinkets).
**Hunter's Mark** when it is not on the target (you are the raid's only hunter).
**Serpent Sting** when it has {Refresh at} s or less left.
**Queue Raptor Strike** after your last shot before you step in: any shot, your Auto Shot too, cancels it.
**Move in** to {Melee spot} yd once your Auto Shot has fired and you have cast Arcane Shot, Multi-Shot or Serpent Sting (if one is up).
**Immolation Trap** within 6 yd of the target.
**Before moving out**, wait for your melee swing if it lands in under 1 s.

texts.text: **Before moving out**, wait for your MH melee swing if it lands in under 1 s.

simple.text: **Move out** to {Ranged spot} yd once your swing has landed, you have cast one melee ability (if one is up), and Arcane Shot or Multi-Shot is ready or Serpent Sting is running out.

texts.when: Off hand swing > 0 and Weave play < 2
texts.text: **Move out** to {Ranged spot} yd once your MH and OH swings have landed, you have cast one melee ability (if one is up), and Arcane Shot or Multi-Shot is ready or Serpent Sting is running out.
